look.decision: Painted Room (Bold): gallery-green walls, white Bodoni wall lettering, OpenAI Sans for everything ChatGPT says; the green wall becomes the Mac wallpaper

transitions.decision: One oner through a real 3D gallery with resting frames, hard cuts velocity-matched; signature seam 5>6: the press lands the window, the walk rewinds in 1 s onto the toast frame, then the room folds flat into the Mac (floor to Dock, wall to wallpaper) under a dolly-zoom. The exit line lands in the placard's exact slot. Passed over crossfades between exhibits: the walk must feel continuous

motion.decision: Spine 'the thing in front': the gallery moves behind, a screen-locked placard stays in front until the ChatGPT window takes its place. Motif: the text cursor (alive, dead exhibit, alive again). Depth: scenes 1-6 a real 3D gouache gallery on one 28 mm rail, parallax only; 7-8 flat and locked.
